rules: Never use a guide PNG or enlarged source alpha as production art.
Render native high-resolution transparent ink art into each complete logical Sprite canvas.
Do not align to a tight PNG crop center or multiply integer crop pixels by24.
All four parts share sourcePPU100 -> nominal drawingPPU2400; geometry scale is not inferred from opaque art height.
Bone pivots may be transparent; contour observations and underlap allowance have separate meanings.

The final fullcanvas art keeps these normalized anchors. Any actual exported image dimensions must be recorded and converted from full-canvas normalized coordinates, not assumed from the requested size.
